theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_ald_ld_weighted_density_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (M E : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → NullMeasurableSet E μ → E ⊆ M → (∀ z ∈ M, 0 < θ z) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (E ∩ ball y r)), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in E ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ) / (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
